sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx focal plane array, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK; optical: 1/1.8in progressive scan CMOS, 4 MP
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum network positioning system (PTZ)
thermal module: 640x512 VOx uncooled, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD <= 35 mK, 8-14 um
thermal lens 50 mm F1.0 (min. focusing distance 50 m)
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 6-240 mm 40x motorized zoom lens
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/- 8 C (fire-prevention exception alarm)
dynamic fire detection, up to 10 fire points
laser IR illuminator up to 800 m
built-in GPU intelligent perimeter protection VCA: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit
wiper, alarm I/O, BNC analog video output (thermal channel)
PTZ: pan 360 continuous, tilt -90 to +40, 300 presets
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD6267-50H4L is a thermal (640x512) and 4 MP optical bi-spectrum network positioning system with a built-in GPU for perimeter-protection VCA, temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C) and fire detection, aimed at large-area perimeter protection such as airports, railways and parking lots. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 and thermal is Channel 2, exposed as separate streams. PTZ via ONVIF.
